acceptance: Each statement is confirmed or refuted by a run against a disposable tractable store with two clients sharing one actor, and the commands and results are recorded on this item.
A refuted statement is corrected in `docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md`; a confirmed one is left as is.
No write reaches the `todo-state` branch of the project store during the test.
description:
`docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md` (section 'Two layers', changed in PR #4170) makes two claims that were inferred and never exercised:
1. 'Leaders that share one identity can claim each other's members.' Inferred from PR #3957, which reports four leaders registering the same owner, and from the tracker treating the owner as an identity. Not tested against tractable 1.1.1.
2. A `prepare` made by a shared-identity member appears in the batch's integration log and is therefore treated as the leader's by `_check_member_writes`. Inferred from the exemption built from `integration_log` entries of kind `prepare`; whether a member-made prepare is logged that way was not tested.

Guardrail: test against a throwaway local state remote, never the project's tracker store.
